notes.title: Official Release - Launch Discount!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29769237/73ae8f71c6707c586655141cb20a1c72e762aab1.gif

The Automatician has just released on Steam! Buy it now with a special launch discount at €5! We invite you all to play this game on which we’ve worked so very hard over the past two years. We’d like to thank everybody in the team and at NHTV (our university) for making this possible!
